name: Search Multiple Hashes
description: Look up a list of hashes against what PolySwarm already knows: a read-only search that submits nothing, one API request per distinct hash. PolySwarm has no batch endpoint, so a list of fifty hashes costs fifty requests; duplicates are only paid for once, lookups run sequentially, and a usage limit, a refused key, an unreachable platform, three failures in a row or a ten minute time bound stops the run and returns what was already gathered. The run branches on a malicious count above zero with no detection threshold, unlike Search Hash. A hash that could not be checked, for any reason, routes the run to partial rather than to a clean answer.

hashes.description: Hashes (SHA256, SHA1 or MD5) to look up. Read-only: nothing is submitted to PolySwarm. At most 100 distinct hashes per call, and each distinct hash costs one PolySwarm API request.

include_assertions.description: Include the individual engine verdicts for every hash. Off by default, because it makes the result much larger.

results.description: One row per hash that PolySwarm returned a verdict for

hash.description: The hash as it was looked up

malicious_count.description: Number of engines that returned a malicious verdict

benign_count.description: Number of engines that returned a benign verdict. Engines that abstained are counted in neither column.

total_count.description: Total number of engines that returned a verdict

polyscore.description: PolySwarm threat score (0.0 - 1.0). Null when PolySwarm returned no score.

permalink.description: Link to the PolySwarm scan result

family.description: Malware family name, when the metadata carries one

assertions.description: Individual engine verdicts, present only when include_assertions is set

engine_name.description: Name of the engine that returned this verdict

author_name.description: Name of the party that authored the engine

verdict.description: True for malicious, false for benign. Null when the engine abstained rather than answering.

errors.description: Hashes that could not be looked up, with the reason for each

hash.description: The hash this error applies to

reason.description: Why this hash could not be looked up

requested_count.description: Number of distinct hashes to look up after deduplication

queried_count.description: Number of PolySwarm API requests this call spent, one per hash looked up

rate_limited.description: True when a usage limit stopped the run before every hash was looked up

outputs.detected: At least one of the looked up hashes was detected by PolySwarm, and every hash that was queried was checked
outputs.not detected: PolySwarm returned a verdict for every hash that was queried and none was detected
outputs.partial: At least one hash could not be checked, because a usage limit stopped the run, a lookup failed, a hash was malformed, the run was stopped early, or a scan has no final verdict yet. The results are incomplete and must not be read as a clean answer. A run that found a detection can still take this branch when another lookup failed, so read results on this branch too. A scan that closed with no engine verdict is also reported here, as an error, never as not detected.
